title: Normalized affine degree comparison homomorphism
statement: For affine étale objects U and W of X, g : W → U, quasi-coherent F on X and degree n, there exists an additive-group morphism from the lifted Amitsur degree term to the lifted singleton tensor-section Čech degree term, with the original pure-tensor normalization but without an invertibility assertion.

proof.text: Identify the affine product P with the spectrum of the indexed tensor power. Apply affine pullback sections to P → U and U*F and normalize the composite pullback by its unit equation. Lift the comparison and invert evaluation of the singleton outer product. Check its pure-tensor formula.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03P2, affine-case identification, expanded using Tags 01I9 and 01IA

lean.statement:
theorem exists_singletonTensorDegreeComparison_hom
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent]
    (U W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ U) (hU : IsAffine U.left) (hW : IsAffine W.left)
    (n : ℕ) :
    ∃ f : (singletonTensorAmitsur X F U W g).X n ⟶
      (singletonTensorCech X F U W g).X n,
      IsSingletonTensorDegreeComparisonHom X F U W g n f
